# 60-day supply simulation

Scenario model begins with 10B supply and 1B reserve. Each day reserves 1M; met distributes it without reducing supply, missed burns it. 90%-hit meets days 1-54 and misses 55-60. Worst-case misses every day. Entry minting and tier burns are excluded.
